children: Oceaneering reported third-quarter 2026 results with consolidated revenue of $784.6 million and operating income of $92.2 million. The company generated adjusted EBITDA of $119.4 million and free cash flow of $142.0 million for the quarter, while net income attributable to Oceaneering was $52.6 million. Oceaneering reiterated expectations for continuing share repurchases and provided initial 2027 consolidated EBITDA guidance of $430 million to $480 million.
Revenue: $784.6 million for Q3 2026, up 6% year-over-year (Q3 2025: $742.9 million).
Gross margin: $164.6 million (gross margin amount reported); gross margin implied from reported figures (gross margin value provided as $164,558 thousand).
Operating income: $92.2 million for Q3 2026, up 7% year-over-year (Q3 2025: $86.5 million).
Net income attributable to Oceaneering: $52.6 million for Q3 2026 (Q3 2025: $71.3 million).
Adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP): $119.4 million for Q3 2026; EBITDA (non-GAAP) reported at $98.2 million.

Subsea Robotics (SSR) improved year-over-year results with revenue of $233.0 million, operating income of $75.4 million and an EBITDA margin of 39%; ROV revenue per day utilized rose to $11,781 with ROV utilization at 65%.
Manufactured Products revenue increased 8% to $168.2 million; backlog at September 30, 2026 was $435 million and the 12-month book-to-bill ratio was 0.77.

Offshore Projects Group (OPG) performance remained relatively flat, aided by a favorable mix of installation projects that offset lower activity in West Africa and a less favorable mix in the U.S. Gulf.

Integrity Management & Digital Solutions (IMDS) saw a 7% revenue increase with higher activity in the Middle East, Europe and the U.S. Gulf, partially offset by changes in project mix and increased costs in the Middle East.

Aerospace and Defense Technologies (ADTech) revenue rose 7% to $135.1 million, with operating results affected by increased pass-through activities and certain program costs; third-quarter bookings included meaningful awards across SSR, Manufactured Products and ADTech.
